strings: After zooming around for most of the day m_c comes over to r_c0's den to sheepishly ask for some help with the new bruises {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} obtained.
No serious harm has come to m_c from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} zooming, just a few extra knocks and bruises.
m_c trots into camp unabashed, only slightly wincing from a couple of bruises.
